messages:
emily: Heads up — 3.2.0 cutoff in ~4 hours. Please bump any final deps, push changelog entries, and tag PRs for cherry-picks. We need the RC cut to be synced to `rc/3.2` by cutoff. :clock4:
raj: Quick Q — are we locking feature branches or just main for merges? I have a small perf tweak that needs to go in.
emily: Locking merge to main only after the cutoff. Perf tweak should target `rc/3.2` if it needs to land now. Otherwise hold for next patch.
sasha: I'm blocked on a flaky test in runtime; can we skip it for the canary and still run canary rollouts?
kevin: We can skip the flaky unit test for the canary if we add a follow-up ticket and re-enable before GA. Need :+1: from QA.
emily: @kevin can you file a ticket and tag @qa? Don't skip changelog though — small note is fine.
release-coordinator: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled at 20:00 UTC. Will run 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics pass. :robot_face:
deploy-bot: deploy started for rc/3.2 -> canary at 20:02 UTC
raj: Pushing cherry-pick now. Command I used:
```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b fix/perf-cherry origin/rc/3.2
git cherry-pick abc1234
git push origin fix/perf-cherry
``` 
sasha: FYI test infra report: flaky test reduced but still 12% fail rate in nightly. I'm disabling it temporarily in the canary job: `ci/canary/config.yaml` changed.
kevin: @sasha add the test ticket link pls.
sasha: https://tracker.redwood.internal/T-2412 — will re-enable after root cause.
emily: If canary fails at 50% we'll rollback to previous. If 10% shows latency regression we abort early. I'll post status in #announcements once we have canary pass/fail.
raj: canary pass at 20:22 UTC at 50% with no regressions. :tada:
deploy-bot: canary promoted to 100% at 20:28 UTC
emily: Announcing GA ETA: rolling to all at 20:35 UTC. I'll ping #announcements now.
kevin: Quick heads up — version bump to 3.2.0 in `package.json` is included in the RC.
emily: Thanks everyone. If anything slips I'll post an update here and in #announcements. :eyes:
